issue_title: Performance regression persists: /projects/note-structurer and /projects/screenshot-to-primevue below 85 for 10+ consecutive audits
issue_body:
# Performance Regression — Project Detail Pages (10+ Consecutive Audits)

Both project detail pages have remained below the 85 performance threshold for at least ten consecutive nightly audits, with no meaningful trend toward improvement. LCP worsened this cycle.

## Current scores (2026-08-21)

| Page | Performance | LCP | TBT | CLS |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/projects/note-structurer` | **80** | 4278 ms | 185 ms | 0 |
| `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | **77** | 4648 ms | 194 ms | 0 |

## Trend
- `screenshot-to-primevue` has been below 85 for **ten consecutive audits** (earliest recorded: 79 → now 77).
- `note-structurer` has been below 85 for **six+ consecutive audits** (83 → now 80).
- LCP on `screenshot-to-primevue` has climbed from ~4296 ms to **4648 ms** this cycle.

## Root cause (likely)
LCP is driven by unoptimized sample thumbnail images and demo assets loaded at full resolution. The single-run Lighthouse methodology means TBT spikes are measurement noise, but the LCP pattern is consistent.

## Recommended fixes
1. **Convert sample thumbnails to WebP** at their actual display size (~300 px wide on desktop).
2. **Add `loading="lazy"`** to all below-fold thumbnail images.
3. **Preload or inline** the drop-zone and result-placeholder SVG icons so the LCP candidate is available sooner.
4. Consider adding an explicit `fetchpriority="high"` on the above-fold LCP image element.

These changes were recommended in previous audits and remain unaddressed.
